Nightly report — night of 2026-09-04 into 09-05, read out at 10:25 CT.

Every figure here was read live from data/admiral.db or from the game itself, not carried over from the plan.

The hull program and fury crystal boards close out work you approved earlier. The clean-bills board is the one to keep.

The reusable page.

Ten tools and stored records reported no problem while a problem was running. Not one threw an error.

The last three are the Admiral's own, added after publication — a feasibility total from a query never asked what it excluded, a price quoted without its ratio, and a ship record a hull behind.

Your question this morning, answered and closed.

Ledger was never blocked. 41 dead orders cleared, the fabricated escrow disproven, and the duplicate-order bug fixed in the harness with tests.
